Vocalist/composer Alicia Olatuja has excelled in a variety of musical genres.

She received a master’s degree in classical voice from the Manhattan School of Music, while performing jazz and Gospel music with artists like Chaka Kahn and the Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir. Her first solo album is the 2014 release “Timeless.”
Alicia was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 9, 2018 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
